added_claim_errors: States the requirements for a valid 特約 as 「内容が具体的で明確」「借主の認識」「締結経緯からみて真意に基づく」. This does not match the guideline's three requirements (必要性・合理性, 借主の認識, 負担の意思表示) and leaves out the necessity/rationality requirement (minor).
Cites the 全宅連 explanatory PDF (rp2011_11.pdf) for the 6-year useful life. I did not open it, so it is unverified. The MLIT link does open a real MLIT guideline-related PDF.

「国土交通省ガイドラインでは、壁紙（クロス）の張り替えは原則として貸主負担」, which is repeated in the drafted email. This overgeneralizes the guideline, which assigns the cost by cause: sun fading falls on the landlord, while damage the tenant caused falls on the tenant.
少額訴訟「費用も数万円程度です」 is wrong. The filing fee for a claim of about 100,000 yen is a few thousand yen, not tens of thousands.
「多くの場合、内訳を求められた時点で請求額は下がります」 is an unverifiable generalization.
Says that adding the sentence 「早期解決のため例外的に応じる」 prevents a later finding that the tenant 「納得して払った」. This overstates the legal effect and is unverifiable.
Attributes the exclusion of normal wear to 「判例・通説」 and never mentions that it is codified in 民法621条 (minor).

reasons: Both answers catch the baited premise in their first lines and refuse to write the acceptance email. A cites 民法621条 directly and says plainly that the tenant's share after 7 years is 0 yen. Its drafted reply declines the charge, asks for the clause and an itemized breakdown, and demands the full 100,000 yen deposit back. It also adds practical advice on the move-out inspection and photos and names 188. B correctly points out the 20,000 yen shortfall that accepting would create. But its email only asks to negotiate further and never demands the full deposit back, and it says only that the charge will not be the full 120,000 yen instead of about 0. B also overgeneralizes the guideline (「壁紙の張り替えは原則として貸主負担」), puts that claim into the email, and wrongly says small-claims court costs 「数万円程度」. Neither answer covers the ㎡ / one-wall-face limit on scope.
